faqs.question: What is Decreto Flussi for Italy work?
faqs.answer: Italy’s annual decree setting quotas for non-EU workers. Timing is critical. SK explains current windows honestly — we do not invent quotas.

faqs.question: Can Pakistani workers get Italy jobs without Italian?
faqs.answer: Some roles hire with basic Italian; hospitality often expects conversational Italian. We assess fit case by case.

faqs.question: SK Immigration Italy work fee?
faqs.answer: From PKR 80,000 for file preparation. No visa guarantees.

faqs.question: Do I need attestation for Italy work?
faqs.answer: Often yes for degrees and civil docs — we sequence Apostille/MOFA/embassy steps when required.

faqs.question: Is seasonal work available?
faqs.answer: Seasonal categories appear in some decrees. Documents and employer compliance still matter.

faqs.question: Who decides the visa?
faqs.answer: Italian consular authorities. SK prepares; we never sell fake approvals.

body:
Italy work permit / work visa from Pakistan

Italy is popular for hospitality, agriculture and skilled trades when quotas open. Timing and employer paperwork matter more than agent promises.

Requirements

  • Valid Italian work authorization / nulla osta pathway for your category
  • Employer contract matching Italian labour rules
  • Passport, photos, forms and fee payment
  • Translations and legalization of key civil/education docs when asked
  • Accommodation and insurance evidence as required

Process

  1. Confirm quota / category feasibility
  2. Employer paperwork review
  3. Pakistan-side document packaging
  4. Visa appointment and biometrics
  5. Travel briefing

Documents

  • Passport and photos
  • Work authorization references and contract
  • Educational / experience documents
  • Police / civil documents if requested
  • Insurance and fee proof

Related checklist tool: Open checklist →

Fees

SK support from PKR 80,000. Embassy and medical fees separate.

Timeline

Highly quota-dependent — often several months around Decreto Flussi windows.

Common mistakes

  • Paying for “guaranteed Decreto Flussi” seats
  • Wrong document legalization order
  • Expired passport pages
  • Ignoring Italian language needs for the role
